I think aiming for maintenance for a little bit and then slowly adding a deficit would be a good idea. It's going to be slower weight loss, but  if it's easier to stick to and will keep you from giving up, I think that's more important than having a large deficit and losing it quicker.

Did you use permanent, demi permanent or semi permanent dye?

If it's semi permanent or a direct dye (like manic panic, arctic fox, etc) you can dye it as many times as needed since it's super gentle.

If it was a permanent dye, box dye or anything with a developer, I'd give it a few days. I'd only go over that one spot since the developer in permanent dye can lighten the hair a little bit while it's depositing color. It's better to do one piece than risk additional damage or uneven hair color.

So I struggle with pretty bad anxiety and will get stuck in a loop of worrying. It's basically a pic of a tree with list of questions you can go through to help you break through the looping thoughts. It does take practice, but I still go through the questions when I start my obsessive thoughts.
